rows.label: qst500205_msg0001
rows.name:
Mo-mo-mo?! I believed you'd come,
mooo!

rows.label: qst500205_msg0002
rows.name:
I felt a one-sided kinship with the
Emperor, entered the audience chamber,
and the soldiers chased me, mo!

rows.label: qst500205_msg0004
rows.name:
But I've had enough, mooo. I want to
hide in a quiet Invidian cave again
and eat mushrooms, mo...

rows.label: qst500205_msg0005
rows.name:
But the Fortis Trade Guild travel
guide says never return to a place
you've already visited, mo...

rows.label: qst500205_msg0006
rows.name:
It's sad, but I'll find another cave,
mo.

rows.label: qst500205_msg0007
rows.name:
Anyway, maybe we meet
again. Best of luck!
